resource.title: Resource
resource.description: UKG Pro WFM resource to extract (one resource per configuration row).

load_type.title: Load Type
load_type.description: Full load replaces all data; incremental load appends new records within a moving date window. Resources without a stable primary key always run full-load.

since.title: Start Date
since.description: Lower bound of the API fetch window. ISO 8601 (e.g. `2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00`) or a relative phrase (e.g. `30 days ago`, `yesterday`).

options.tooltip: Bounds the API fetch and is independent of Load Type. For a primary-key resource on incremental load it seeds the first run, after which the stored state watermark takes over. For full load (and any keyless resource) it is applied on every run.

hyperfind_ref.title: Hyperfind Query
hyperfind_ref.description: Hyperfind query id/name that resolves the employee-ID set for this resource. Leave empty to use the tenant's 'All Home' default.

select.title: Select Fields
select.description: Optional list of API 'select' elements to request. Leave empty to use the resource default.

symbolic_period.title: Symbolic Period
symbolic_period.description: Optional symbolic period used instead of an explicit start/end date window.

options.tooltip: Symbolic periods are UKG-named relative period ranges (e.g. `Current Pay Period`, `Previous Pay Period`, `Yesterday`, `Today`) supplied to the API instead of an explicit start/end date. Applies only to date-windowed resources; ignored otherwise. See the UKG Pro WFM API reference: https://developer.ukg.com/wfm/reference

primary_key.title: Primary Key
primary_key.description: Column(s) that uniquely identify a row; used to upsert on incremental load.

options.tooltip: Column name(s) forming the output table's primary key. On incremental load the component upserts on these columns and the manifest is written incrementally. Supplying a primary key enables incremental upsert even for resources that have no primary key in the built-in registry. Leave empty to use the resource's registry default (a keyless resource then stays full-replace).

max_wait_seconds.title: Payroll Max Wait (seconds)
max_wait_seconds.description: Maximum time to poll a Payroll async export before failing (avoids hanging).

poll_interval_seconds.title: Payroll Poll Interval (seconds)
poll_interval_seconds.description: Seconds between Payroll async export status polls.

page_size.title: Page Size (advanced)
page_size.description: Advanced/testing: override the per-page record count for paginated (apply_read) resources such as People/Persons and Punches. Leave empty to use the resource default.

max_pages.title: Max Pages (advanced)
max_pages.description: Advanced/testing: cap the number of pages fetched for paginated (apply_read) resources. Leave empty for no cap.
